test_merge_basic_join: test the merge function for basic inner, outer, left, and right join operations on DataFrames
test_merge_indicator_column: test the indicator parameter to add a _merge column showing left_only, right_only, or both source rows
test_merge_validation_cardinality: test the validate parameter to enforce merge cardinality constraints like 1:1, 1:m, m:1, m:m
test_merge_categorical_columns: test merging DataFrames on categorical columns with category dtype preservation
test_merge_datetime_tz_columns: test merging on datetime64 with timezone, timedelta, and period index columns
